style: 既存の彩色人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画像。肖像・立ち絵で同じ画像を共用。外見・年代は今回の美術設定で、原文の既定情報ではない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG, delivered as a PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the person. Single adult character, centered waist-up composition, complete hair silhouette and both hands visible, lower edge below the belt, generous empty transparent margins at both sides and above. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen and worn leather, clean readable facial features, muted earth colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. The whole surrounding area is fully empty transparency, including the space beside the shoulders and head. Plain unlettered clothing surfaces. Subject: Mina, an older sister who works in a communal kitchen, an adult woman in her late twenties with warm medium brown skin, an oval face, dark almond-shaped eyes and thick straight dark brown hair gathered into a low bun beneath a small plain cream linen head kerchief. A few wisps frame her forehead. Her expression combines quiet concern with practical warmth, lips gently closed, attentive gaze directed toward the person speaking. She wears a faded muted teal linen blouse with rolled sleeves and a simple clay-brown linen apron tied at the waist over a dark skirt. Her sturdy working hands are empty and fully visible, held loosely in front of her waist with one palm slightly open. Her shoulders are relaxed. The cream kerchief, teal blouse and broad apron create a clear, modest kitchen-worker silhouette.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。人物以外の全域に透明なアルファを持つPNG。成人1人を中央に配置し、髪の輪郭と両手が入り、帯の下で自然に終わる腰までの構図。左右と頭上に十分な透過余白を取る。1024×1536の縦画面。麻と使い込まれた革の質感を備えた緻密な彩色ゲーム人物画。顔の特徴が読み取りやすく、落ち着いた土色、左上からの柔らかい暖色光、目の高さからの斜め正面。肩や頭の周囲も完全な透過。衣服は文字のない無地。人物はミナ、共同の炊事場で働く姉。20代後半の成人女性。温かみのある褐色の肌、卵形の顔、アーモンド形の濃色の目。濃茶色の太い直毛を低いお団子にまとめ、小さな無地の生成り色の麻の頭巾で包む。額の周囲に少し後れ毛がある。静かな心配と生活に根ざした優しさを兼ね、唇を軽く閉じ、話す相手へ注意深く目を向ける。色褪せたくすんだ青緑の麻のブラウスを袖まくりし、濃色のスカートの上から土茶色の簡素な麻のエプロンを腰で結ぶ。よく働く丈夫な両手は空で全体が見え、腰の前で自然に構えて片方の掌を少し開く。肩の力は抜く。生成りの頭巾、青緑のブラウス、幅広のエプロンで炊事場の働き手として明瞭で慎ましい輪郭にする。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG, delivered as a PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the person. Single adult character, centered waist-up composition, complete hair silhouette and both hands visible, lower edge below the belt, generous empty transparent margins at both sides and above. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen and worn leather, clean readable facial features, muted earth colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. The whole surrounding area is fully empty transparency, including the space beside the shoulders and head. Plain unlettered clothing surfaces. Subject: Nagi, Mina's younger brother, a fire carrier who has finished his shift and asked to leave his job. An adult man in his early twenties, slim and slightly tall, with warm medium brown skin, an oval face, dark almond-shaped eyes, thick dark eyebrows and short straight dark brown hair falling forward in an uneven fringe. A clean-shaven face with youthful cheekbones and tired eyes, lips slightly parted, hesitant yet listening. He wears a faded ochre linen work shirt with a soft raised collar under a plain deep slate-blue canvas work vest, reinforced leather shoulder patches, rolled sleeves and a simple brown belt over dark trousers. Both empty hands are completely visible near his waist, fingers loosely curled with a small gap between the hands. His shoulders are slightly drawn inward, suggesting uncertainty while retaining dignity. His short dark hair, narrow blue vest and ochre sleeves distinguish him clearly from his sister.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。人物以外の全域に透明なアルファを持つPNG。成人1人を中央に配置し、髪の輪郭と両手が入り、帯の下で自然に終わる腰までの構図。左右と頭上に十分な透過余白を取る。1024×1536の縦画面。麻と使い込まれた革の質感を備えた緻密な彩色ゲーム人物画。顔の特徴が読み取りやすく、落ち着いた土色、左上からの柔らかい暖色光、目の高さからの斜め正面。肩や頭の周囲も完全な透過。衣服は文字のない無地。人物はナギ、ミナの弟。当番を終えて退職を申し出た火運び。20代前半の成人男性。細身でやや背が高く、温かみのある褐色の肌、卵形の顔、アーモンド形の濃色の目、太い濃色の眉。濃茶色の短い直毛の不揃いな前髪が額へ落ちる。ひげのない若い頬骨、疲れのある目、少し開いた唇。ためらいながらも相手の話を聞く表情。柔らかく立つ襟の色褪せた黄土色の麻の作業シャツの上に、無地の濃い青灰色の帆布の作業ベストを着る。肩に革の補強、まくった袖、濃色のズボンの上に簡素な茶色のベルト。空の両手全体を腰付近に見せ、指を緩く曲げ、左右の手の間には少し隙間を空ける。肩を少し内側へ寄せ、尊厳を保ちながら迷いを示す。短い濃色の髪、細い青のベスト、黄土色の袖で姉とはっきり描き分ける。
